chunks: If you are able to have your fear of Allah intensify, and your good opinion of Him be refined, then combine the two, for the servant's good opinion of his Lord is only to the extent of his fear of his Lord, and indeed the people who have the best opinion of Allah are those who fear Him the most.

key_terms.أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ ظَنّاً: The people with the best opinion

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between fear of God and hope in Islam according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr to balance fear (khawf) and hope/good opinion (husn al-zann) of Allah. The text establishes a direct correlation between the intensity of one's fear and the quality of one's hope, concluding that the most hopeful are the most fearful.
